records.label: spacr.object.merge_split_filter_masks#0
records.source: Merge by perimeter and filter each in-memory field's objects.
records.context: Merge by perimeter and filter each in-memory microscope field of view's objects.
records.translation: 둘레에 따라 병합하고 메모리에 있는 각 시야의 객체를 필터링합니다.

records.label: spacr.object.merge_split_filter_masks#1
records.source: Skips work when no operation is enabled for ``object_type``; otherwise processes each FOV serially so progress reporting stays in order.
records.context: Skips work when no operation is enabled for ``object_type``; otherwise processes each FOV (microscope field of view) serially so progress reporting stays in order.
records.translation: ``object_type``에 활성화된 작업이 없으면 처리를 건너뜁니다. 그렇지 않으면 진행 상황 보고의 순서가 유지되도록 각 FOV(현미경 시야)를 순차적으로 처리합니다.

records.label: spacr.object.merge_split_filter_masks#2
records.source: 2D/3D ndarray or iterable of masks (one per field).
records.context: 2D/3D ndarray or iterable of masks (one per microscope field of view).
records.translation: 2D/3D ndarray 또는 마스크를 담은 이터러블입니다(시야당 마스크 하나).

records.label: spacr.object.merge_split_filter_masks#3
records.source: Original own-channel arrays matching the masks, required only when an intensity bound is enabled. For channel-last batches the first channel must be the object's own channel.
records.context: Original own-image data channel arrays matching the masks, required only when an intensity bound is enabled. For image-channel-last batches the first image data channel must be the object's own image data channel.
records.translation: 마스크와 대응하는 객체 자체 채널의 원본 배열이며, 강도 한계가 활성화된 경우에만 필요합니다. 채널 축이 마지막인 배치에서는 첫 번째 채널이 객체 자체 채널이어야 합니다.

records.label: spacr.object.merge_split_filter_masks#4
records.source: Dict of pipeline settings; per-object-type suffixes control perimeter merging, min/max area, border removal and min/max intensity. Intensity bounds compare whole-object means in original image units; equality is retained and 0 disables each bound independently.
records.context: Key-value mapping of workflow settings; per-object-type suffixes control perimeter merging, min/max area, border removal and min/max intensity. Intensity bounds compare whole-object means in original image units; equality is retained and 0 disables each bound independently.
records.translation: 파이프라인 설정 딕셔너리입니다. 객체 유형별 접미사는 둘레 기반 병합, 최소/최대 면적, 경계 객체 제거, 최소/최대 강도를 제어합니다. 강도 한계는 객체 전체의 평균 강도를 원본 영상의 단위로 비교합니다. 한계와 같은 값인 객체는 유지되며, 0은 각 한계를 서로 독립적으로 비활성화합니다.

records.label: spacr.object.merge_split_filter_masks#6
records.source: Optional per-FOV filenames used only for logging.
records.context: Optional per-FOV (microscope field of view) filenames used only for logging.
records.translation: 선택적인 FOV(현미경 시야)별 파일명이며, 로그 기록에만 사용합니다.

records.label: spacr.object.merge_split_filter_masks#7
records.source: Original ``masks`` unchanged when no operation is enabled, else a list of filtered mask arrays (one per FOV).
records.context: Original ``masks`` unchanged when no operation is enabled, else a list of filtered mask arrays (one per FOV (microscope field of view)).
records.translation: 활성화된 작업이 없으면 원래 ``masks``를 변경 없이 반환하고, 그렇지 않으면 필터링된 마스크 배열 목록을 반환합니다(FOV당 하나).

records.label: spacr.object_roles.split_role_setting#4
records.source: a settings key.
records.context: a setting name.
records.translation: 설정 키입니다.

records.label: spacr.pipeline_v2.stream_masks_from_stack#3
records.source: C-axis indices selected out of each assembled stack before it is handed to Cellpose — taken modulo the channel count and de-duplicated in order. It is NOT forwarded as Cellpose's ``channels=`` argument; ``[0, 0]`` therefore yields a single plane, not a grayscale pair. The first selected channel is the object's own channel for absolute mean-intensity filtering.
records.context: C-axis indices selected out of each assembled stack before it is handed to Cellpose — taken modulo the image data channel count and de-duplicated in order. It is NOT forwarded as Cellpose's ``channels=`` argument; ``[0, 0]`` therefore yields a single image layer, not a grayscale pair. The first selected image data channel is the object's own image data channel for absolute mean-intensity filtering.
records.translation: 조립된 각 스택을 Cellpose에 전달하기 전에 선택하는 C축 인덱스입니다. 채널 수로 나눈 나머지를 취한 뒤 순서를 유지하면서 중복을 제거합니다. 이 값은 Cellpose의 ``channels=`` 인수로 전달되지 않습니다. 따라서 ``[0, 0]``은 회색조 평면 한 쌍이 아니라 단일 영상 평면을 만듭니다. 첫 번째로 선택한 채널이 절대 평균 강도 필터링에 사용하는 객체 자체 채널입니다.

records.label: spacr.pipeline_v2.stream_masks_from_stack#5
records.source: how many field stacks to load into memory at once. Larger = faster but more RAM.
records.context: how many field stacks to load into memory at once. Larger = faster but more RAM.
records.translation: 한 번에 메모리에 로드할 시야 스택의 수입니다. 수가 클수록 빨라지지만 더 많은 RAM이 필요합니다.

records.label: spacr.pipeline_v2.stream_masks_from_stack#6
records.source: human name to record for the appended mask channel (default ``"mask"``).
records.context: human name to record for the appended mask image data channel (default ``"mask"``).
records.translation: 추가된 마스크 채널에 기록할 사람이 읽기 쉬운 이름입니다(기본값 ``"mask"``).

records.label: spacr.pipeline_v2.stream_masks_from_stack#7
records.source: the intermediate batch is compressed to an NPZ under ``npz_dir`` on every batch regardless; this flag only decides whether that file and the scratch folder survive the run.
records.context: the intermediate batch is compressed to an NPZ under ``npz_dir`` on every batch regardless; this flag only decides whether that file and the scratch folder survive the processing session.
records.translation: 이 플래그의 값과 관계없이 매 배치의 중간 데이터는 ``npz_dir`` 아래의 NPZ 파일로 압축됩니다. 이 플래그는 실행이 끝난 뒤 해당 파일과 임시 폴더를 보존할지만 결정합니다.

records.label: spacr.pipeline_v2.stream_masks_from_stack#8
records.source: where to write the (optional) intermediate NPZ files. Defaults to a scratch subfolder under the stack folder.
records.context: where to write the (optional) intermediate NPZ files. Defaults to a scratch subfolder under the stack folder.
records.translation: 선택적인 중간 NPZ 파일을 기록할 위치입니다. 기본값은 스택 폴더 아래의 임시 하위 폴더입니다.

records.label: spacr.pipeline_v2.stream_masks_from_stack#9
records.source: optional :class:`spacr.illumination.SegmentationIlluminationSession`. Its corrector sees private selected-channel copies immediately before normalisation/Cellpose; persisted intensity planes and scratch NPZs remain raw, and completion is recorded only after the combined stack has been atomically replaced.
records.context: optional :class:`spacr.illumination.SegmentationIlluminationSession`. Its corrector sees private selected-image data channel copies immediately before normalisation/Cellpose; persisted intensity image layers and scratch NPZs remain raw, and completion is recorded only after the combined stack has been atomically replaced.
records.translation: 선택적인 :class:`spacr.illumination.SegmentationIlluminationSession`입니다. 이 세션의 보정기는 정규화/Cellpose 직전에 선택된 채널의 별도 전용 복사본만 사용합니다. 영구 저장된 강도 평면과 임시 NPZ 파일은 원시 상태로 유지되며, 결합된 스택이 원자적 연산으로 교체된 후에만 완료를 기록합니다.

records.label: spacr.setting_animations.animation_for_setting#0
records.source: Return the animation mapped to ``setting_key``, if one exists.
records.context: Return the animation mapped to ``setting_key``, if one exists.
records.translation: ``setting_key``에 대응하는 애니메이션이 있으면 반환합니다.

records.label: spacr.setting_animations.animation_for_setting#1
records.source: exact, case-sensitive settings key to look up.
records.context: exact, case-sensitive setting name to look up.
records.translation: 조회할 정확한 설정 키이며 대소문자를 구분합니다.

records.label: spacr.setting_animations.animation_for_setting#2
records.source: Exact matches take precedence. A numbered organelle slot can reuse its primary slot's animation through the shared slot-name mapping; unknown settings and case variants still do not acquire unrelated help.
records.context: Exact matches take precedence. A numbered organelle slot can reuse its primary slot's animation through the shared slot-name mapping; unknown settings and case variants still do not acquire unrelated help.
records.translation: 정확한 일치가 우선합니다. 번호가 있는 세포소기관 슬롯은 공유 슬롯 이름 매핑을 통해 기본 슬롯의 애니메이션을 재사용할 수 있습니다. 알 수 없는 설정이나 대소문자만 다른 이름에는 여전히 관련 없는 도움말이 제공되지 않습니다.

records.label: spacr.settings.surviving_setting_name#3
records.source: A setting may have been renamed more than once. Older files need every hop resolved so their values reach the name the current run reads.
records.context: A setting may have been renamed more than once. Older files need every hop resolved so their values reach the name the current processing session reads.
records.translation: 하나의 설정 이름이 여러 번 변경되었을 수 있습니다. 오래된 파일의 값이 현재 실행에서 읽는 이름에 도달하려면 이름 변경의 모든 단계를 해석해야 합니다.

records.label: spacr.settings.surviving_setting_name#5
records.source: the key a settings file carries.
records.context: the structured-data name a settings file carries.
records.translation: 설정 파일에 들어 있는 키입니다.

records.label: spacr.settings.surviving_setting_name#6
records.source: a tuple of the names read today -- empty when ``key`` is current, withdrawn, unknown, or resolves through a cycle.
records.context: a tuple of the names read today -- empty when ``key`` is current, withdrawn, unknown, or resolves through a cycle.
records.translation: 현재 읽는 이름들의 튜플입니다. ``key``가 현재 이름이거나, 폐기되었거나, 알 수 없거나, 이름 해석 과정에서 순환에 도달하면 빈 튜플입니다.

records.label: spacr.utils.merge_split_objects#0
records.source: Merge by perimeter and filter labeled objects across a directory of masks.
records.context: Merge by perimeter and filter labeled objects across a directory of masks.
records.translation: 마스크 디렉터리 전체의 레이블이 지정된 객체를 둘레에 따라 병합하고 필터링합니다.

records.label: spacr.utils.merge_split_objects#1
records.source: Runs the shared in-memory merge/filter pipeline on each mask file in ``mask_src`` in parallel, overwriting each mask in place.
records.context: Runs the shared in-memory merge/filter workflow on each mask file in ``mask_src`` in parallel, overwriting each mask in place.
records.translation: ``mask_src``의 각 마스크 파일에 공유 인메모리 병합/필터 파이프라인을 병렬로 실행하며, 각 마스크 파일을 같은 위치에서 덮어씁니다.

records.label: spacr.utils.merge_split_objects#3
records.source: directory of matched original intensity images, required when either intensity bound is enabled.
records.context: directory of matched original intensity images, required when either intensity bound is enabled.
records.translation: 대응하는 원본 강도 영상의 디렉터리이며, 두 강도 한계 중 하나라도 활성화되면 필요합니다.

records.label: spacr.utils.merge_split_objects#4
records.source: explicit channel-last index for multi-channel intensity images; unnecessary for single-channel planes.
records.context: explicit image-channel-last index for multi-image data channel intensity images; unnecessary for single-image data channel image layers.
records.translation: 채널 축이 마지막인 다중 채널 강도 영상에서 사용할 명시적 채널 인덱스입니다. 단일 채널 평면에는 필요하지 않습니다.

records.label: spacr.utils.merge_split_objects#5
records.source: minimum shared-boundary fraction for perimeter-based merging.
records.context: minimum shared-boundary fraction for perimeter-based merging.
records.translation: 둘레 기반 병합에 필요한 최소 공유 경계 비율입니다.

records.label: spacr.utils.merge_split_objects#6
records.source: remove objects smaller than this (px); 0 disables.
records.context: remove objects smaller than this (px); 0 disables.
records.translation: 이 값보다 면적이 작은 객체를 제거합니다(px). 0은 이 필터를 비활성화합니다.

records.context: remove objects larger than this (px); 0 disables.

records.source: drop objects touching the image border.

records.translation: 병렬 작업 프로세스 수입니다.
